body.x: STAGE8 has introduced web music and sound content platform in 'MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT'(BOOTH # 52843) of CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the largest technology show in the world held in Las Vegas, USA for four days starting from January 8 (Tue).

Music platform, STAGE8, is developed for a purpose to harmonize both musician and content-creating company. Through this platform, users can publicly inquire certain concept of BGM, sound, or SFX, and the musicians would upload music according to the inquiry which would be paid by the user for choosing among the created music.

This web music platform improves the existing work process of the music market and provides an opportunity to musicians for economic profit. Also, users having difficulties with the existing process of finding adequate music would be provided with an extensive range of music.

The characteristics of STAGE8 are online inquiry and purchase of sound content, recommendation service for musician sound content to reduce time loss of users, and web content service which has various sound content ideas of musicians.
